Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 37%. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 123 identities means 123 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
